# Fox Baltimore (WBFF)

> > Local Baltimore news, weather, sports, and breaking news coverage from Fox45, serving the Maryland region with investigations, community features, and public safety reporting.

Fox Baltimore (WBFF/FOX45 NEWS) is the primary local news source for the Baltimore metropolitan area and Maryland, providing comprehensive coverage of local politics, crime, education, lifestyle, and breaking news. The station maintains multiple investigative series examining governance, public safety, and consumer issues affecting the community.

## Key Topics

- Baltimore news
- Maryland politics
- Breaking news
- Local government
- Crime reporting
- Public safety
- Education & schools
- Community events
- Investigations
- Weather forecasts
- Lifestyle & entertainment
- Consumer protection
- House of Delegates
- Senate President Ferguson
- FOX45 NEWS

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [Baltimore News, Weather, Sports, Breaking News](https://foxbaltimore.com): WBFF Fox45 homepage providing Baltimore local news, weather, and community coverage
- [Local](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/local): WBFF Fox45 local news section covering Baltimore and Maryland communities
- [Nation & World](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/nation-world): National and international news coverage including politics, security, and breaking news
- [Fox45 Mornings](https://foxbaltimore.com/fox45-mornings): Fox45 morning show with local news, lifestyle segments, and community features

## Investigations & In-Depth Reporting

- [City in Crisis](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/city-in-crisis): Investigation series examining Baltimore governance, politics, and urban challenges
- [Gun Trace Task Force](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/gun-trace-task-force): Investigation series on Baltimore Police Gun Trace Task Force corruption scandal
- [Crisis in the Classroom](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/crisis-in-the-classroom): Investigation series covering education crises including student safety and school issues
- [Inside Your World](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/inside-your-world): Investigative journalism series covering consumer issues and public safety concerns
- [Spotlight on America](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/spotlight-on-america): Investigation series on healthcare, drug safety, cybersecurity, and consumer protection

## Government & Politics

- [Full public records exemption for IGs is 'unlikely,' Senate President Ferguson says](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/local/full-public-records-exemption-for-igs-is-unlikely-senate-president-ferguson-says): Maryland Senate President Ferguson discusses public records exemption for inspectors general
- [House gives initial OK to foster care package, including 'Kanaiyah's Law' and hotel bans](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/local/house-gives-initial-ok-to-foster-care-package-including-kanaiyahs-law-and-hotel-bans): Maryland House approves foster care reform package including Kanaiyah's Law legislation
- [Baltimore Connect to Congress](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/connect-to-congress): Congressional news and political coverage including federal legislation and investigations

## Crime & Public Safety

- [Maryland's Most Wanted](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/marylands-most-wanted): U.S. Marshals and FBI most wanted fugitives in Maryland and Baltimore area
- [Baltimore County police arrest suspect in road rage shooting](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/local/baltimore-county-police-arrest-suspect-road-rage-shooting): Baltimore County police arrest suspect in Friday morning road rage shooting incident
- [Undocumented immigrant sentenced to prison for $3 million money laundering scheme](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/local/undocumented-immigrant-sentenced-prison-million-money-laundering-scheme-maryland): Togo immigrant Gedeon Agbeyome sentenced for $3 million money laundering scheme in Maryland

## Lifestyle & Community Features

- [BMORE Lifestyle](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/bmore-lifestyle): Baltimore lifestyle news covering entertainment, health, wellness, and community events
- [Maryland Moments](https://foxbaltimore.com/news/maryland-moments): Feature stories highlighting Maryland community profiles and human interest stories
- [Amazing America](https://foxbaltimore.com/amazing-america): Travel guide featuring American destinations, attractions, and weekend getaway ideas
